title: Validate D&D class, ancestry, and spell choices from generated pack
description:
Add generated-rules-pack-backed validation for D&D class, ancestry, and spell choices in the new recipe/engine path. This may share code with the resolver migration bead but should be tested from the character creation engine perspective.

Requirements
- Class validation resolves generated class records and uses class hitDie where needed.
- Ancestry validation resolves generated ancestry records by display name/common alias.
- Spell validation resolves generated spell records and checks class availability and spell level from generated data.
- Spell validation waits for class when class is not yet known.
- Error messages are field-specific and actionable.

Acceptance criteria
- Fighter, Wood Elf, Wizard, and representative SRD spell names validate by display name.
- Invalid spell for selected class explains the class mismatch.
- Spell selection before class reports that class is required instead of cascading.
- Tests cover generated data typed guards and invalid/missing prerequisite behavior.
notes: PR #300 open for review: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/300. Added level-1 spell-level validation (was missing; class availability already enforced) + sharper class-mismatch message in characterDraft.ts. Engine-perspective tests (display-name resolution, valid/over-level/off-list/unknown spells, spell-before-class pending no-cascade, invalid class/ancestry) and resolver typed-guard tests (malformed class/spell -> malformed vs not_found). Note: acceptance named 'Wood Elf' which is not in SRD 5.1 (pack ships High Elf); tests use High Elf. verify:worktree green (2466 passed/19 skipped). Unblocks b69j.8/.9.
